# snarkjs 0.7.6 corresponding source

Source: https://github.com/iden3/snarkjs/tree/v0.7.6

The upstream config/, source, templates, package manifest and lockfile are supplied unchanged. The npm-distributed src/ files were compared byte-for-byte with this tag. Use the upstream build scripts and dependency versions in this directory; BROWSER=true commands use POSIX shell syntax (or set BROWSER in PowerShell). The generated StepFund verifier is renamed to AcceptanceVerifier; its GPL-3.0 notice is preserved.
